entries: One creature you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. It does so with {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} if you or your allies are fighting it. On a failed save, the target has the {@condition Charmed|SRD52} condition until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it. The {@condition Charmed|SRD52} creature is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} to you. When the spell ends, the target knows it was {@condition Charmed|SRD52} by you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.
